sources.entry: MindNode - Mind-mapping software with an emphasis on simplicity and ease-of-use.

summary.name: MindNode
summary.one_liner: MindNode is a mind-mapping and outlining app for capturing, linking, and organizing ideas visually, with sync across Apple devices.
use_cases: planning weekly schedules and life goals
creating study guides and lecture summaries
summary.what_it_does: MindNode lets you capture ideas on an open canvas and link them together. You can switch between a mind map view and an outline view as your structure develops. Thoughts can be grouped, reordered, and connected to build clarity. The page says the app is designed for Mac, iPad, iPhone, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro, with sync between devices. It says data is stored encrypted in the user's personal iCloud.
notable: Switch between mind map and outline views as structure emerges
Data stored encrypted in personal iCloud with sync across devices
Native design for Apple platforms including Vision Pro and Apple Watch
Owned by its founder and funded by users rather than investors, per the page
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platforms are Apple devices only; no Windows, Linux, or web version is named
